items.item_text: Certified Nursing Assistant: CA, upon hire and
Basic Life Support - CPR, upon hire
Minimum of six months experience inacute care or skilled facility
Uphold patient rights and cultural dignity by respecting diverse belief systems and utilizing professional translation services to ensure clear communication and strict adherence to privacy policies.

Perform comprehensive patient assessments and care planning by recognizing age-appropriate needs, identifying high-risk conditions like falls or skin breakdown, and reporting findings to the nurse in a timely manner.

Implement and evaluate the delivery of patient care by completing scheduled rounds, maintaining accurate documentation, answering call lights promptly, and assisting the healthcare team with bedside procedures and protocols.

Support patient and family education by informing them of visitation policies and daily routines while reporting any learning barriers or language preferences to the nursing staff to improve outcomes.

Foster effective teamwork and technical competency by maintaining professional collaboration, adhering to the chain of command, participating in improvement strategies, and demonstrating proficiency in all required clinical equipment and procedures.
Must be able to take call, float to other areas, and work on weekends and holidays as required
